messages.subject: Error running app using runUrl
parts:
Hi all,

I saved my app as a zip file and put it in my Public folder on Dropbox. The scripts ui.R and server.R are saved in the folder myapp inside the zip file. When I typed 
runUrl("http://...") # public URL of my zip file

I received this error:
Error in setwd(appDir) : cannot change working directory

There are no calls to setwd in my R codes, so it's not clear to me what the problem is. Previous threads mentioned this error too but the fixes suggested don't apply/help here. Would appreciate any suggestions!

Thanks!

- JinRou
